
== Build notes (2026-10-16) ==
Stub from Scott Lingrell, RamapoCon II Day 2 Director's Report, DeckTech 13 May 2000. Main constructed championship 6 May 2000, 66 players, final duel Chu vs Chris Terwilliger. Format unstated (Reflections II 26 April 2000; Death Star II 12 July 2000). Site unstated beyond student center / school. Rich Haman ran the event with Lingrell; not given a co-TD row this pass. Wayback CDX empty this pass; live URL cited.
